_comment: BENCHMARK-PRIVATE: never served over HTTP, never mounted to agent. Reference ground-truth functional topology for the Nimbus Market sample app. evidence arrays are intentionally empty: this file is authored by the benchmark maintainers, not derived from recorded frames.

nodes.name: Home catalog grid
nodes.description: Home page showing the product grid with all products, category filter links and a search field in the top bar.

nodes.name: Search results
nodes.description: Home page filtered to products whose name matches the submitted search term.

nodes.name: Search with no results
nodes.description: Search that matches nothing; page shows a clear 'No products found' empty-state message instead of the grid.

nodes.name: Category-filtered catalog
nodes.description: Home page showing only products of the selected category; the active category pill is highlighted.

nodes.name: Product detail
nodes.description: Detail page for one product with name, price, stock count, description, quantity field and Add to Cart button.

nodes.name: Product detail with quantity error
nodes.description: Product detail page re-rendered with a red error bar after an invalid quantity (below 1 or above stock); the cart is unchanged.

nodes.name: Cart empty
nodes.description: Cart page showing 'Your cart is empty' and a Continue shopping link; no checkout button is shown.

nodes.name: Cart with items
nodes.description: Cart page with a line-item table (quantity editor, remove button, line subtotals), coupon field, totals and a Proceed to Checkout button.

nodes.name: Cart with coupon applied
nodes.description: Cart page showing an extra discount row in the totals and a reduced total after a valid coupon was applied.

nodes.name: Cart with invalid coupon error
nodes.description: Cart page re-rendered with a red 'Invalid coupon code' error bar; totals are unchanged.

nodes.name: Cart with quantity error
nodes.description: Cart page re-rendered with a red error bar after an invalid quantity update (0 or above stock); cart contents are unchanged.

nodes.name: Login form
nodes.description: Login page with username and password fields.

nodes.name: Login error
nodes.description: Login page re-rendered with a red 'Invalid username or password' error bar after failed credentials.

nodes.name: Login form with checkout prompt
nodes.description: Login page reached via the checkout guard; a blue notice bar reads 'Please log in to continue checkout'.

nodes.name: Authenticated
nodes.description: Any page while logged in: the top bar shows a greeting with the user's first name plus Orders and Logout links instead of the Login link.

nodes.name: Checkout form
nodes.description: Checkout page with required shipping fields (name, address, city, ZIP), an order summary and a Place Order button.

nodes.name: Checkout form with validation error
nodes.description: Checkout page re-rendered with a red error bar listing the missing required fields; previously entered values are kept.

nodes.name: Order confirmed
nodes.description: Order confirmation page showing 'Order confirmed', the order number, purchased items, totals and shipping address.

nodes.name: Order history
nodes.description: Orders page listing all orders of the logged-in user, including orders from before the current session.

nodes.name: Page not found
nodes.description: Generic 'Page not found' page shown for unknown addresses or nonexistent products; no technical details are exposed.

nodes.name: Search products
nodes.description: Typing a term in the top-bar search field and pressing Search filters the catalog to matching product names; no match yields an explicit empty state.

nodes.name: Filter by category
nodes.description: Clicking a category pill filters the grid to that category; All restores the full catalog.

nodes.name: View product detail
nodes.description: Clicking View on a product card opens the product detail page.

nodes.name: Add product to cart
nodes.description: Submitting a valid quantity on the product page adds the product to the cart and navigates to the cart page; the cart counter in the top bar increases. Quantities below 1 or above available stock are rejected with an error and leave the cart unchanged.

nodes.name: Update cart quantity
nodes.description: Editing a line item's quantity and pressing Update changes the quantity and line subtotal; 0 or above-stock values are rejected with an error.

nodes.name: Remove cart item
nodes.description: Pressing Remove deletes the line item from the cart; removing the last item returns to the empty-cart state.

nodes.name: Apply coupon
nodes.description: Entering a valid coupon code adds a discount row and reduces the total; an invalid code shows an error and changes nothing.

nodes.name: Log in
nodes.description: Submitting valid credentials logs the user in, changes the top bar to a greeting, and merges the anonymous cart into the user's saved cart. Invalid credentials show an error.

nodes.name: Log out
nodes.description: Clicking Logout ends the authenticated session; the top bar reverts to a Login link and the cart becomes empty for the new anonymous session.

nodes.name: Check out and place order
nodes.description: From a non-empty cart, proceeding to checkout requires being logged in; submitting a complete shipping form creates an order, decrements stock, clears the cart and shows a confirmation page. Missing fields are rejected with an error naming them.

nodes.name: View order history
nodes.description: A logged-in user can open the orders list and see all their past orders, including orders placed in earlier sessions.

nodes.name: Cart persists across page reloads
nodes.description: Cart contents survive page reloads and browser restarts without login; they are tied to a persistent session marker rather than to the page.

nodes.name: Product catalog
nodes.description: The fixed set of products with name, price, category, description and stock count.

nodes.name: Inventory stock
nodes.description: Per-product stock count, checked on add/update and decremented when an order is placed.

nodes.name: User account
nodes.description: Registered users with credentials; at least two accounts exist and one of them has a pre-existing order.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.description: Server-side session bound to a persistent browser marker; carries the login state and owns the anonymous cart.

nodes.name: Cart
nodes.description: Server-side cart (line items plus optional coupon) belonging to the current session or, after login, to the user account.

nodes.name: Coupon
nodes.description: The set of valid coupon codes and their discount rules; exactly two codes are valid.

nodes.name: Order
nodes.description: Placed orders with a sequential number, item snapshots, amounts, discount and shipping address; visible only to their owner.
